note_tweet.text: #WATCH | Kolkata, West Bengal: Antonio Enrico Bartoli is the Ambassador of Italy to India, said, "It's my second time. I think it's an incredible experience—an experience of the crowd, the devotion, and at the same time the curiosity to see the creativity expressed in the different pandals. So I definitely wanted to come back. I think it's one of the deepest expressions of the relationship with spirituality, but there is also a very artistic... It's like a sacred carnival... I think we have common heroes and we have common values..." (13.10)
